# Zeeshan Abid

> Zeeshan Abid is a multi-disciplinary designer based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, working professionally since 2017 in branding, motion graphics and animation, social media, digital and print marketing, UI/UX, service design and photography.

## Key facts

- Location: Toronto, Ontario, Canada
- Experience: designing professionally since 2017
- Services: Branding, Motion graphics, Animation, Social media design, Digital marketing design, Print and packaging design, UI/UX design, Service design, Photography, Design research
- Industries: fashion, advertising, healthcare, retail, tech, apps, food, cannabis, automotive, events
- Contact: https://maira-abid.github.io/Zeeshan-Portfolio-Site/contact/

## Projects

- [CarSwitch Animations](https://maira-abid.github.io/Zeeshan-Portfolio-Site/projects/carswitch/): Three humorous motion graphics animations that explain how CarSwitch makes buying and selling a used car easy. Client: CarSwitch, Dubai, UAE. Categories: Animations / Videos, Social Media. Results: 3 animated videos for social media and YouTube; 35k views on Instagram + Facebook; -30% social media queries; +50% customers visiting the website.
- [Evercare Hospital Animations](https://maira-abid.github.io/Zeeshan-Portfolio-Site/projects/evercare/): Four explainer animations that helped the public understand COVID-19 at a time of confusion and panic. Client: Evercare Hospital. Categories: Animations / Videos, Social Media. Results: ~20K average views per animation; -40% common COVID-19 queries; 4 explainer animations.
- [Pizza Now](https://maira-abid.github.io/Zeeshan-Portfolio-Site/projects/pizza-now/): A mid-tier pizza brand, created from scratch, that became the highest selling brand on the Byte app. Client: Byte Technology Systems. Categories: Branding. Results: #1 selling brand on the Byte app for 1 year; 50-60% of all daily sales on the app.
- [Breakfast Box](https://maira-abid.github.io/Zeeshan-Portfolio-Site/projects/breakfast-box/): A premium yet playful cloud-kitchen breakfast brand that drove 150-200 orders a day after launch. Client: Byte Technology Systems. Categories: Branding. Results: 150-200 orders per day for the next 4 months.
- [Black Friday Sale](https://maira-abid.github.io/Zeeshan-Portfolio-Site/projects/black-friday/): A turquoise-on-black Black Friday campaign across email and social that lifted product sales by 60-70%. Client: Multiverse / XP Enterprise / Milkyway Glass. Categories: Digital Marketing, Social Media. Results: +60-70% product sales over Black Friday; 4.67% email click rate.
- [Collegiate Survival Sale](https://maira-abid.github.io/Zeeshan-Portfolio-Site/projects/collegiate-survival-sale/): A rough, chaotic back-to-school campaign that tripled sales and sold 60% of stock within five days. Client: Multiverse / XP Enterprise / Milkyway Glass. Categories: Digital Marketing, Social Media. Results: 3x sales; 60% of stock sold in 5 days; 5x more products sold than on a regular day (approx. 180); 2.2% email click rate.
- [Annual Winter Sale](https://maira-abid.github.io/Zeeshan-Portfolio-Site/projects/annual-winter-sale/): A newspaper advertisement for the launch of Generation's Annual Winter Sale, adapted for print, web and social media. Client: Generation. Categories: Print Marketing.
- [Generation Magazines](https://maira-abid.github.io/Zeeshan-Portfolio-Site/projects/generation-magazines/): Editorial design for three Generation magazines, shown together as one project. Client: Generation. Categories: Print Marketing.
- [Byte App](https://maira-abid.github.io/Zeeshan-Portfolio-Site/projects/byte-app/): A redesign of the Byte food delivery app to be easier to use and look more contemporary. Client: Byte Technology Systems. Categories: UI/UX.
